# Awesome JEV

> Awesome JEV is a free directory of TypeSafe Jev / System One GitHub projects. Find agents, SDKs, apps and developer tools, with source-backed inclusion notes and repository links.

Snapshot: 2199 GitHub projects; 280 news summaries.

## Reading boundaries

This is a free community directory, not an official TypeSafe product. Listing is not a security, compatibility or maintenance certification. Repository descriptions are author statements, not inclusion evidence. Independent alternatives do not imply Jev API compatibility or affiliation. Stars and news are build-time snapshots. Cite the original source and say explicitly when a document cannot be accessed.
